content: Hello! how can I help today?
My home was damaged in a federally declared disaster. How do I claim a casualty loss?

1. Confirm the disaster was federally declared (see FEMA site)
2. Compute the loss: Lesser of basis or property value decrease
3. Subtract $100 per event and 10% of AGI
4. Report on Form 4684, then flow to Schedule A
Can I amend last year’s return?
Yes. Under IRC §165(i), elect to claim the loss in the prior year to speed up refund.
